address: via Crosette 34, località Costorio, Concesio, 25062, Italy
bio: A French-Italian couple is at the helm in this attractive classic-style villa on the outskirts of Brescia, where a few tables have been laid out in the bay windows overlooking the garden. The Miramonti l'Altro has made history in Brescia and Lombardy by bringing together diverse gastronomic influences: the French origins of chef Philippe Léveillé explain the use of delicious ingredients from France, which are combined with a reinterpretation of classic Italian and Mediterranean dishes. The story doesn’t end here, however, as the cuisine continues to evolve and surprise even its most regular guests. Don’t miss the unforgettable cheese trolley which boasts an extraordinary selection....
